full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. Well, thank you very much, everybody. I want to just thank you for being with us. And I assume the press is ready.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: We have a Pulitzer Prize–winning photographer. Unfortunately, he gets it for a shot at the ear. Someday you'll get it for something nice. You'll get it for something nice, Doug [Doug Mills, New York Times].

full_topic_context.speaker: Reporter
full_topic_context.text: Q. Thank you, sir.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. Well, I want to just thank everybody. It's been a very special trip, and I can tell you that our country is hot. It's hot as a pistol. Never—I don't even think—it's never been so hot.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And if you go back 6 months, it was the exact opposite. We had a man that couldn't even stand up. He was so terrible. What—it's so terrible what he's done to our country, but we've turned it around so quickly. I did not expect to turn it around this quickly.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I think we're the hottest country in the world right now. And 6 months ago, they were laughing at the United States, but they don't laugh anymore.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: This has been an amazing trip. And as you know, I'm going to U.A.E. in a little while. We're going to first watch an air show that will be spectacular from our friend, the Amir. He's done a great job. Done a great job.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And I've met such great people. And as you know, that—we're trying to give Yemen a chance, and we're going to give Syria a chance. With Yemen, they have a tremendous Houthi problem. I believe that's a problem for them. You know, you never really know. This is a tricky part of the world.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But we were asked to stop firing at the Houthis, and that's something that they've never asked, because they're tough, and they're good fighters and all, but they're not going to be blowing ships out of the water anymore. So that's what we wanted, and we'll see how that works.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But their emissaries were very, very strong on it. So that's giving—that's a good thing for Yemen, because they want to try and—they're trying to help themselves also. And we want them to get along with Saudi Arabia, because that's been a—that's been a big fight.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And the other, of course, is Syria. We took out the sanctions. And that's been—I didn't even realize it's been many, many years that they've had sanctions. And as you know, there was a very big change at the top, and I thought that we have to give them a chance. They really have no chance with the sanctions. They were very biting. They were top of the line. Nobody could even deal with them. You couldn't even—you couldn't make a phone call to Syria. So we did that.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And I met the new leader of the country, and he's got a, you know, strong past. I'll be very nice. He's got strong past, but I liked him a lot. I think he'll be a great representative, and we'll see. He—you're going to have to have a strong past to put that one around. You can't—you cannot be a weak person. If you're a weak person, we would just be wasting time. So he's a strong guy, and I thought he was good, and let's see what happens. But we're going to give him a fighting chance by taking off the sanctions.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So we've actually been praised for that. The Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia was very strong, "Please do that." He wanted it done.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And President of Turkey wanted it done. President Erdoğan called me. He said, "Is there any

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: way you could do that, because if you don't do that, they don't have a chance."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And so I did it, and it's actually been very popular. The Amir liked it a lot. It's been very, very popular. So, let's see what happens, but it's my honor to have done it.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And with that, we're surrounded by the—some of the greatest businesspeople in the world.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: We just had a tremendous order of Boeing. This is Boeing, and this is General Electric.

full_topic_context.speaker: Editorial
full_topic_context.text: [At this point, the President gestured toward Boeing Co. Chief Executive Office Kelly Ortberg and General Electric Aerospace Chief Executive Officer H. Lawrence Culp, Jr.]

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And General Electric, I hear, makes the best large airplane engine in the world by not even a contest. Maybe I'll have to change my engines one day in my plane—[laughter]—because they're not General Electric, but, you know, it's one of those things. But I hear you make the best engines in the world, Larry. Larry is—somehow, his people are General Electric.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: First of all, it's one of the greatest turnarounds that you'll ever see in a company, because when you took it over, it was—I want to be respectful—General Electric was in trouble, to put it—I would say—right?—to put it mildly. And now it's a hot company doing great.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And it's—I would imagine the hottest thing is what's happened with the engine division, because this engine is incredible.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Would you like to say a couple of words, Larry, about that? Because he watches—when he sees Boeing, he gets—he's very excited because he supplies, I guess, for the most part, the engines.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Would you like to say something?

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Culp. Sure. Well, Mr. President, thank you, and it's an honor to be here. We're thrilled about the commitment that Qatar Airways has made to both Boeing and GE Aerospace——

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. Yes.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Culp. ——with the largest wide-body order, really, in our company's history: over 400 engines, both our——

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. Wow.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Culp. ——our GEnx, which powers the 787, the fastest-selling high-thrust engine in history, and our new 9x will power the 777X, which will be the largest commercial engine in the world.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. Will that be the same engine other than size, or is it different?

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Culp. It's a step forward and a generation forward as well.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. So even beyond——

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Culp. Yes.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. ——the large one.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Culp. Very much so.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. That's great.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Culp. And we think that really helps both Boeing and GE Aerospace continue to support not only our investment in domestic manufacturing but, in turn, everything that we're doing to drive the $75 billion annual trade surplus that the aerospace industry enjoys in the U.S. today.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: So, we're excited. I know Kelly and the Boeing team have been great partners.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Culp
full_topic_context.text: But, Badr, our thanks to you for your trust and your commitment to both GE Aerospace and Boeing. We're—we're gratified.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. Yes. Thank you very much. Kelly, go ahead, please.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Ortberg
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Ortberg. Well, Mr. President, first of all, thank you for your support. This is a major order for us. All of these aircraft will be built in the United States, creating significant number of jobs. And I know that's a key mission of yours, and this order, will help us accomplish that.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Ortberg
full_topic_context.text: Partnership with GE has been great. They do power exclusively our engines, and they're doing a great job here. And we're very pleased to be selected by Qatar for this largest aircraft— wide-body aircraft order in the history of Boeing. A major, major accomplishment for us, and thanks to the administration for your support.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. That's the largest order you've ever had, right?

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Ortberg
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Ortberg. Yes, for wide-body aircraft.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. So one of the largest orders in history. But it almost has to be—if it's the largest order you've had, has to be pretty close to the largest order ever made, right?

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Ortberg
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Ortberg. Yes. Yes, that's correct.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. And you also—Boeing also got the jet fighter. We selected Boeing for the jet fighter, the state-of-the-art, highest level. It's an amazing-looking plane. If it functions as well as it looks, I think we're going to have a big—[laughter]—we're going to have a big winner.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But we're also looking at some additional jet fighters. We have some really good ones that we have—we're taking a look at—strong look from one of your competitors——

full_topic_context.speaker: Mr. Ortberg
full_topic_context.text: Mr. Ortberg. Yes.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The President. ——I must say. And we're doing something very special. But it's a special country.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: You know, we were losing the Middle East because the past administration didn't handle the relationship properly, didn't show the kind of respect that they deserve.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And me, I have a lot of respect, and I have a lot of liking. I like the Crown Prince a lot—I've known him a long time—in Saudi Arabia. And the amir is fantastic.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And we're going to another country in a little while, U.A.E.—a fantastic man, fantastic leader. And they have great leadership talents in this part of the world, and that's why they're doing so well.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And you probably read today the story about Iran has sort of agreed to the terms. They're not going to make—I'll—I call it, in a friendly way, "nuclear dust." We're not going to be making any nuclear dust in Iran. And we've been strong.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I want them to succeed. I want them to end up being a great country, frankly, but they can't have a nuclear weapon. That's the only thing. It's very simple. It's not like I have to give you 30 pages worth of details. There's only one sentence: They can't have a nuclear weapon.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And I think we're getting close to maybe doing a deal without having to do this—there's two steps. There's a very, very nice step, and there's a violent step. Violence like people haven't seen before. And I don't—I hope we're not going to have to do this. I don't want to do the second step. Some people do. Many people do. I don't want to do that step.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So we'll see what happens. But we're in very serious negotiations with Iran for long-term peace. And if we do that, it will be fantastic—and for this country, in particular, because you're right next door. You're a stone's throw away. Not even, right? You're a foot away. You can walk right into Iran. Other countries are much further away, so probably it's not quite the same level of danger.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But we are going to protect this country. It is a very special place with a special royal family. And the head of the royal family is—two heads of the royal family, really, if you think—great— it's great people, and they're going to be protected by the United States of America. And I think we're not going to have to do it, because I believe very strongly in peace through strength.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Now, we just gave out, in the budget, a $1 trillion budget, which is the biggest we've ever done. A trillion dollars. Never came close to a number like that. We'd be at 800—we'd be at $800 billion. We'd be at maybe 900, 910. We never got anywhere close to a trillion, but we're doing it.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Hopefully, we will not have to use these weapons. We make the greatest weapons in the world. We make the greatest fighter jets. We make the greatest—I guess Larry would know better than anybody, but we make the greatest planes in the world, the greatest missiles and defense systems.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: The Patriot system is the best—acknowledged to be. This isn't from me. And we have a lot of it now. It's under order, and we're coming up with new systems.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And we're coming up with a new system of drones, because drones are really—if you look at the war that's going on, it's horrible, but we are watching it very closely, and drones really seem to be taking over that war. And so I hope you're going to come up with some nice, inexpensive engine for a drone so that we don't have to spend so much. [Laughter]

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I asked one of the companies—I said, "I want a lot of drones." And you know, in the case of Iran, they make a good drone, and they make them for $35-, $40,000, so I said to this company, "I want to see it." They came in two weeks later with a drone that cost $41 million. I said: "That's not what I'm talking about, $41 million. I'm talking about something for $35-, $40,000 where you send thousands of them up."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And that's a great way—and they're very good, too, and fast and deadly—horrible, actually.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: When you look at what's happening with Russia and Ukraine, the drone is killing tremendous numbers of people. You hide behind a tree, and the drone comes down, and it circles you with— with fire. You don't have a chance. The tree comes down also, by the way. It's so intense. The trees—I mean, you see these trees being knocked down like—like—they're being sawed down by a top-of-the-line timberman. Like—like—you know who? Sean Duffy.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Do you know that Sean Duffy, the head of the Transportation Department, who's working right now on the airports and getting a system—because Biden didn't do a thing for 4 years, and Pete Buttigieg was the head, and he goes bicycling to work. He's—he takes a bicycle to work. Can you believe he's head—he's running the biggest air system in the world, and he takes a bicycle to work? What a—and—and they say he's going to run for president. I don't see it. Who knows, right? But I don't see it.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But when I look at what they've done, it is so horrible what they have done. And the work they did do, they wasted billions of dollars. They tried to hook up air systems to copper, and they

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: tried to hook up copper to glass, and the glass doesn't work with the copper. And they had 30,000 different contractors doing 30,000 jobs.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And when they put it all together—they spent billions of dollars—it didn't even come close to working. And we're going to be giving out a brandnew system. It's very important. We'll have the best system. And we think we know who that system is, but we have a lot of bidding.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But we want one check. We want a unified system. We don't want to have 5,000 contractors in all different places, some digging ditches and some not doing ditches because they want to go by satellite. Satellite seems to be the way to go. But—so we're going to be giving that out pretty soon.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But what people don't know about Sean, because I mentioned lumberjacks, that, Sean—you probably didn't know this, that—I'm not talking about this Sean. This Sean, no, not—this is not. This is a different Sean. Sean Duffy, the head of Transportation. He's a great Sean, though, I have to tell you.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But Sean Duffy was the world champion for 5 years, climbing trees and down, up and down—world champion. So that's what you call a serious lumberjack. And he's doing a fantastic job too. A really respected guy and a terrific guy.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And I mentioned the champion, because when somebody is a champion—he's the world champion for a long time. He came down—when you come down those trees, coming down at— at a rapid—he said, "That started getting your back—you will often break your back." You miss a shot, and you're coming down a lot faster than the human body was meant to come down. But he's doing a fantastic job at Transportation.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But this has been a very historic trip. I watched some of the people talking about it, and even what I would perceive as enemies of ours—people that are not fair from the press—are saying it's been amazing. We've raised trillions of dollars in investments. It's been—there's never been anything like it.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And just to finish, we have a country that now has—I think, Howard, we can say that—at least $10 trillion of investment and potential investment. And if the past administration did a half a trillion dollars, it was, like, a lot. But we did it in 2 months, because it's actually a little more than three months, but I always say the first month, I had to get a little bit acclimated, so I didn't really do this the first. But when we started—so we've really been doing it—Susie, right?—for 2 months. So, in 2 months, we're going to have over $10 trillion. Nobody's ever come close—no country has ever come close to that. No country.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And I want to thank the amir, because he put up a lot and—in terms of investment. It could amount to 2 million, 3 million, maybe even 4 million jobs in the United States.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And more importantly, it's really important stuff. It's tremendous refining capabilities. It's capabilities for very high-end—AI is a big subject, and it's a big subject over here too. I always say, "What are you investing in?" It seems one thing everybody seems to have in common is AI.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So I don't know if that's a good thing or a bad—maybe you shouldn't do it because too many people are doing it, or maybe you should follow the crowd, fellas. Okay. So you'll—you're going to figure it out.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: We have a man who's here who has been unbelievable: Scott Bessent, who's our Secretary of the Treasury and who's so respected. When he speaks on television, it's like everyone just says, "Oh, okay." I had somebody the other day—he said, "Well, Scott Bessent said." I said, "Well, that's pretty good, Scott, you know." [Laughter] So I'm a believer. I'm a believer. But when he speaks, the markets really listen.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And the big thing is that we have—to me, the most important thing of all is that—forget about the recent stock market being so good. Much more importantly, we have hundreds of different big companies pouring into America now, creating jobs like we have never seen before.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Now, the bad news, it takes a little while for that to—you know, when you build your factory, and it takes a year and a half, 2 years. And they're going to build them very fast, and they don't need financing. That's the nice part. They don't need any financing. They have plenty of it.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But they're building factories at levels—we've never seen anything like it. And these are, you know, $10 billion, $12 billion, $50 billion. I said, "How do you spend $50 billion on a factory?" We have the chip companies coming in from Taiwan. We have Jensen, as you know, coming in with $600 billion.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: We have the—actually, the biggest company of them all. You know all about it—coming in.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: That was a big—Mr. Wei. I said, "Mr. Wei, you're a smart man, aren't you?" I never met him. And I said, "Because I understand you control 99 percent of the chips." "Oh, yes. Oh, yes, I do." I said, "That's pretty good." I said, "Is there any way of breaking that grip?" They said it would take you many years. So I said: "You know what? If you can't beat him, you join him." But he's going to be building the biggest factory anywhere in the world in Arizona and spending over

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: $200 billion.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And we have Apple, as you know, that's coming in. And I had a little problem with Tim Cook yesterday. I said to him: "Tim, you're my friend. I've treated you very good. You're coming in with $500 billion, but now I hear you're building all over India. I don't want you building in India. You can build in India if you want to take care of India, because India is the highest—one of the highest tariffed nations in the world. It's very hard to sell into India." And they've offered us a deal where—where basically they're willing to literally charge us no tariff.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So we go from the highest tariff, you couldn't do business in India—we're not even a top 30 in India because the tariff is so high—to a point where they have actually told us—I assume you too—Scott, you were working on that also—that there will be no tariff, right? Would you say that's a difference? They're the highest, and now they're saying, "No tariff."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But I said to Tim—I said: "Tim, look, we've treated you really good. We put up with all the plants that you built in China for years. Now you've got to build us—we're not interested in you building in India. India can take care of themselves. They're doing very well. You're—we want you to build here." And they're going to be upping their production in the United States—Apple. So Apple is already in for $500 billion, but they're going to be upping their production, so it'll be great.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So I really think we have—we've gone from a laughing stock 6 months ago to the hottest country anywhere in the world. And that's not just in business, that's in everything else, and it's psychologically hot too.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And I just want to thank everybody for being here.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I want to thank the media. The media, I have to say, has been very fair. They've been very fair. They've been terrific, actually. I was watching some of our—normally, they would not say good things, but they're having a hard time saying bad because this is a record tour. There's never been a tour that will raise—it could be a total of three and a half, four trillion dollars. This—just in this four or five days, and it's from great people.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And our relationship now is very strong with Saudi Arabia. Nobody's coming—nobody is going to be bothering that relationship. Nobody would be able to break that relationship because of my relationship with the Crown Prince and the family. The relationship is really strong.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And when you talk about Qatar, the relationship is equal. I mean, it's just like nobody is going to break that relationship. We've never—we have never had a relationship with Qatar as strong as it is now. You know that better than anybody, and they're very happy, and we're going to protect you. We're going to protect you. That's the one thing you need, maybe, but I don't think you're going to need too much of that.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And I said last night—it was a great meeting, great everything. They brought in Lee Greenwood to sing. It was a beautiful—it was a beautiful evening, and I appreciate it.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But I said last night that Iran is very lucky to have the Amir, because he's actually fighting for them. He doesn't want us to do a vicious blow to Iran. He says: "You can make a deal. You can make a deal." He's really fighting. And I really mean this. I think that Iran should say a big thank you to the amir because the amir is fighting very much that we don't.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And there are many people that want me to go the other route. They say, "Just knock it out," because nobody can beat us. No—we have the strongest military in the world, by far—not China, not Russia, not anybody. We have the best military equipment in the world. And we have the strongest military in the world.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: If you remember ISIS—General "Razin" Caine, right?—we knocked it out in 3 weeks. Remember, they said it would take 4 years to knock out ISIS? We did it in 3 weeks. That's because you had the right leader. With a stupid person, you'll, you know, do it in—you'll do it in 4 or 5 years. You won't even do it. You'll fight for 4 years, and then you'll leave, you know, like we always do. You fight, fight, fight.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: We had a President that blew up half the Middle East, and then he left. That was it. You know, it was like—spent $10 trillion on blowing up the Middle East, and then he left. Just said, "Let's leave now." We left with nothing.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And we don't do that. We take care of our friends.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And so you have a great ally in us, and there's nobody even close. In terms of military power, there is nobody close. And I'm not only talking about nuclear. I don't like to mention the word, because the nuclear is so destructive that, you know, it brings you into a different category. But we're number one in nuclear.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I rebuilt our military, by the way, in my first term. We—I—we had a really successful first term. Then the election was rigged, and I had to wait. And it became more historic, and I was able to watch and see.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And the good news is, they—although, it's bad news in another way, but the good news is that Biden was so bad—worst President we've ever had by far. There was never a President like this. This man was grossly incompetent, and now that's been proven. But people were able to see how bad it is, and it gave me a mandate.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: We won all seven swing States. We won the popular vote by a lot. We won the counties by 2,725 to 505. That's why the map is completely red. When you look at it, the map—it was a—it was an obliteration, this election, and we got 312 electoral votes. So it's—it was just an obliteration. And that means mandate. And we have a mandate that nobody's had.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: They said, "The most consequential election"—and this was a enemy paper—"the most consequential election in 129 years."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So it's been a tremendous trip. I've really liked it. You know, look, this is going—we're going 20 hours a day. And people say, "How do you do it?" And I said, "I do it because I like it. I like it. I like the people I'm dealing with."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I said last night they—we—I stood in a line for—it seemed like hours. I said hello to Larry. I said hello to Kelly. I said hello to your 250 competitors. I said hello to everybody. [Laughter] And that was a long sucker, I want to tell you. [Laughter] They say, "How do you do it?" I said, "I do it because I like the man standing on my left." And I said it two nights before about the crown prince, but last night I had the amir, and he's fantastic. And I said, "It's really not hard."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: You know, when you like the people and when you are doing something—we have a term: MAGA, Make America Great Again. A very simple term. And I remember Biden saying, "We will not let MAGA take over this country." I said: "No, no, you stupid person. It says, 'Make America Great Again.' It's okay if it takes over the country. It's called Make America Great Again."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And that's where we are right now. It's America—we'll put America first. But because we're putting it first, we're doing so well. There's going to be plenty left over to help the world, and we can help the world psychologically. So we think we're going to do well with Russia-Ukraine. Five thousand soldiers are being killed every single week, on average. Five thousand.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And they're not from here, and they're not from the U.S.A. They're from Ukraine and Russia.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So some people would say, "Why are you bothering?" Because these are 5,000 young people. Well, they're getting older because they've gone through so many that they are actually getting older. But these are 5,000 people that leave their home, wave goodbye to their parents. Their parents are so proud of them—their sisters, their brothers—and that's the last they ever see them. They're wiped out.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And if you would see the satellite pictures—I get satellite pictures of that battlefield, and I want to tell you, I've never seen anything like—I wish I never saw it. You have heads and arms and legs strewn all over the field, and you just take a look at that. And you know, when you think, 5,000 a week on average, and that's actually a no—a low number.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So we're going to see if we can end that.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I was thinking about going, but it's very tough because of what we're doing today and tomorrow. But you know, if something happened, I'd go on Friday, if it was appropriate. But we have people right now negotiating, and I think that—I just hope that Russia and Ukraine are able to do something, because it has to stop. Not only the money—we spent $350 billion there. Just handed it. Nobody even knows where the money—they just send them a check. There's no accounting. There's no one. It's just, "Give them money."

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Every time this—every time he came—I have to hand it to him. I think he's the greatest salesman maybe in history. [Laughter] Every time he came to the United States, he'd walk away with $100 billion. You know, that's a good salesman, right?

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Even by your standards. This is a big standard right here.

full_topic_context.speaker: Editorial
full_topic_context.text: [The President gestured toward Minister of State for Energy Affairs Saad Sherida al-Kabi of Qatar.]

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But that's a pretty good standard—no, he'd walk in, leave with $100 billion. Last time he didn't do as well. He only got $60 billion. [Laughter] And it was so easy. It was like taking candy from a baby. That was the last administration. This administration has been a little bit tougher.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But we'd like to see it end, and I think we're going to have a chance at doing it.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And we'd like to see if we could solve the Iran problem in an intelligent way, as opposed to a brutal way. There's only two: intelligent and brutal. Those are the two alternatives.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So I want to thank everybody for being here very much. And we're going to take some questions, and perhaps now we'll ask the press to leave, and we're going to see you at the airfield. We're going to have a display of American equipment.

full_topic_context.text: [Several reporters began asking questions at once.]

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Okay, yes. Jennifer [Jennifer Jacobs, CBS News], go ahead. [Several reporters spoke at once.]

full_topic_context.text: But we have people there. Marco, as you know, is doing a fantastic job. Marco is there, secretary of State, and we have people there. But I don't—I didn't think it was possible for Putin to go if I'm not there.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Jennifer.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. The golf course is designed by an American golf architect, Kyle Phillips.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Oh, yes.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. And it's one of the top 50 golf courses around the world.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. He's good.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. Of course, Mr. President, the UFC are our great partners, and everything we do, Mr. President, is about long-term partnerships. We have hosted this partnership since 2010, and we've extended it until 2029.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Good.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. We host several fights here in Abu Dhabi. We host a fight night, and we have the championship fight every October. We're also working currently, Mr. President, to have a center of excellence with the UFC here in Abu Dhabi.

full_topic_context.speaker: Managing Director Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Managing Director Al Mubarak. Also, we've been an investors in the UFC, Mr. President, since 2010.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. And there's nobody better than Dana White. Managing Director Al Mubarak. We made a lot of money with him. Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed. He's a good friend of ours.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. That's good. He's a great guy.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. Mr. President, jiujitsu is our national sport, and we export jiujitsu to all over the world, and predominantly one of our biggest partners is the U.S., where we host several championships throughout U.S. cities. Last year, we hosted the world jiujitsu championships in Dallas. That's a partnership we want to grow. There's 40 events launched in 20-

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: —since 2009.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Wow.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. Mr. President, sports—again, we have a fantastic relationship with the National Basketball Association, where we host exhibition games every year here in Abu Dhabi. Thousands of fans from around the world experience this fantastic sport. Since we've partnered with the NBA, there has been a 50-percent increase in regional participation between young boys and young women.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Wow.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. Also, Mr. President, we do sponsorship deals with the Boston Celtics, the New York Knicks, and Madison Square Garden.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Of course, you can't go to Yas Island without being a home of entertainment. Last year, we had 111 events, 1.6 million attendees—musical events from all over the world, predominantly from amazing musical artists coming from the United States of America.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: And of course, to host them moving forward, we're going to host them in the Sphere Abu Dhabi, similar to the one that's in Vegas——

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Right.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. ——but this is the 2.0 version.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mixed
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Similar size? Chairman Al Mubarak. Yes, sir. President Trump. Very good.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. Twenty-two thousand.

full_topic_context.speaker: Mixed
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. It's a good one, yes. Chairman Al Mubarak. And this right here—— President Trump. It's bigger, I think.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. This will be slightly bigger, and the technology will be slightly enhanced, Mr. President.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Thank you. Mr. President.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Thank you very much.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: That's amazing. These are all American companies. They're doing very well here. We work together. So it's not only the investment coming in by the hundreds of billions into our country, like you see in Oklahoma, like you see all over many of the jobs with Exxon and Boeing and so many great companies, but we work together, and the money that's made here comes back to us. And many of the contractors, I would imagine, come even for this.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. Yes, sir. President Trump. They come from here. Chairman Al Mubarak. Architects.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Plus a lot of the entertainment itself comes here.

full_topic_context.speaker: Chairman Al Mubarak
full_topic_context.text: Chairman Al Mubarak. Yes, sir.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. So it's a—it's an incredible thing.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Now, here's the good news. I've been doing this for 4 days. I leave now and get onto a 42- year-old Boeing. But new ones are coming. New ones are coming.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And it's been an incredible—actually, an incredible 4 days. It's—I want to thank your family.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Your family is so unbelievable, the job they've done.

full_topic_context.speaker: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed
full_topic_context.text: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed. Thank you, sir.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. And your father has been really incredible. The job they've done here is incredible, and we've made it work.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And you know, they were being wooed by others, but there's no more wooing. I think we're in pretty good shape.

full_topic_context.speaker: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed
full_topic_context.text: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed. Absolutely.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. There's no more wooing. I've been friends with these leaders—the three leaders, in particular, that we saw over the last 3, 4 days, 5 days. And they're great people.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: They're great people, and they love our country, and we love them.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So it's been a tremendous time, and now it's time to go back home. My daughter had a baby.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: I'm going to go back home and see that little baby. And then we get back to a lot of work.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: We'll see what happens with Russia and Ukraine. I think it's something that's—it's just—we got to stop the killing. Five thousand people a week. Five thousand young people a week, on average, being killed in a war that is going nowhere. It's a shame. Should have never happened.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But we have other things to do also. Plus, we have an Iran situation, which we're going to take care of. One way or the other, we're taking care of it. It will be taken care of 100 percent. It will be done nicely or not nicely—and the "not nicely" is not a good thing for them. And I think—we're talking to them, and they're—I think they've come a long way.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So I just want to thank—the media has been very fair, I have to say, and they've been—they realize the importance of what we've done here. And it really is, and it's an honor. And it's sort of easy for me, because I know the people. I've known them—I've known your father for a lot longer than I've been in politics, because I did have another life that was a very good life and a very successful life.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But this is something that's really successful, because we're doing it for 325 million people.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And the United States now is the hottest country anywhere in the world.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And you see that even with enlistments—military enlistment setting records. Six months ago, you couldn't get anybody to go into the military and so many other things.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So we're just doing great. We have probably, I was saying 2 days ago, 10—we have $10 trillion of investment, and now the $10 trillion is probably $12- or $13-, I think, Scott and——

full_topic_context.speaker: Secretary Bessent
full_topic_context.text: Secretary Bessent. Yes, sir.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. ——Howard. I think we're probably looking at $10- to—now we're looking at thirteen—maybe $13 trillion. These are numbers that nobody's ever—even you guys, you've never heard of numbers. [Laughter] This—these are numbers that nobody's ever——

full_topic_context.speaker: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed
full_topic_context.text: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed. We're not as big as——

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. ——ever heard of before.

full_topic_context.speaker: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed
full_topic_context.text: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed. We're not as big as the United States, Mr. President.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. No, you're not. You'd better not be. [Laughter]

full_topic_context.speaker: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed
full_topic_context.text: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed. But we punch above our weight.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. You do. [Laughter] He does. He does. That, I agree. That's right. If you get that big, I'm going to not like you so much anymore. [Laughter]

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: So I want to thank everybody. The media has been great. And we'll see you guys back in Washington, DC. See, even Peter [Peter Alexander, NBC News] is being nice today.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Have a good time.

full_topic_context.text: Russia/Ukraine

full_topic_context.speaker: Reporter
full_topic_context.text: Q. You mentioned Russia. Can we ask you a quick question on that?

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Yes.

full_topic_context.speaker: Reporter
full_topic_context.text: Q. You said that you didn't expect him to go if you didn't go. The question might be, then, when are you going to do it? Why wait?

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. Well, we're going to——

full_topic_context.speaker: Reporter
full_topic_context.text: Q. What's the holdup, so to speak?

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. I think it's time for us to just do it. I said—you know, they all said Putin was going, and Zelenskyy was going. And I said, "If I don't go, I guarantee Putin is not going," and he didn't go. And I understand that.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But we're going to get it—we're going to get it done. We've got to get it done. Five thousand young people are being killed every single week, on average, and we're going to get it done.

full_topic_context.speaker: Editorial
full_topic_context.text: [Several reporters began asking questions at once.]

full_topic_context.speaker: Editorial_heading
full_topic_context.text: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of Ukraine

full_topic_context.speaker: Reporter
full_topic_context.text: Q. Were you surprised when Zelenskyy didn't show up either, sir? Were you surprised when Zelenskyy didn't show up, either?

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. No, he didn't show up because he heard Putin wasn't going, so——

full_topic_context.speaker: Editorial_heading
full_topic_context.text: President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin of Russia/Gaza, Palestinian Territories

full_topic_context.speaker: Reporter
full_topic_context.text: Q. When do you think you'll meet President Putin?

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. As soon as we can set it up. I was going to—I would actually leave here and go. I do want to see my beautiful grandson. It's a son. And we'll be doing that.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: But I will tell you that the world is a much safer place right now, and I think in two or three weeks, we could have it be a much, much safer place. We're going to handle a couple of situations that you have here. We have—you have some very serious situations.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And we're looking at Gaza, and we got to get that taken care of. A lot of people are starving.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: A lot of people are—there's a lot of bad things going on.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: Okay? Thank you all very much.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: And, in particular, I want to thank you, my friend.

full_topic_context.speaker: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed
full_topic_context.text: Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed. Thank you, sir. Thank you.

full_topic_context.speaker: Trump
full_topic_context.text: President Trump. We're going to get everything straightened out.
